The Kaphi Solutions India LLP

Privacy policy

This policy explains what information may be handled when you use this website. The site is a product and equipment catalogue. It does not offer user accounts or send enquiry-form details to a Kaphi server.

Enquiries

When you complete the enquiry form, the details you enter are used to prepare a message for WhatsApp. The message is not sent automatically, and this website does not store your form details. You can review or edit the draft before choosing whether to send it. If you send it, WhatsApp handles the information under its own privacy terms.

Technical information and analytics

This website does not currently use Google Analytics, advertising pixels or analytics cookies. The hosting provider may process standard technical request information to deliver and protect the site. See the provider’s privacy information for details about its practices.

External services

The map image is hosted on this website. Selecting its link opens Google Maps in a new tab, where Google may process technical information. Other external links, including WhatsApp, are subject to those providers’ own privacy terms.

Your choices and contact

Submitting an enquiry is optional. For questions about this policy or help with an enquiry you have sent us, call +91 98804 91458.
